{{Quote|We've got some new xenotoxic flechettes; they worked on the Verpines, maybe they'll work on Killiks.|Sergeant Namada|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''xenotoxic flechette''' was a type of toxin-bearing [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] that was used against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Special Tactics Group 41-Delta]], also known as Bughunter Division, used xenotoxic flechettes in their work.
